notes: Fluids live in a tile's fluid layer (amount 0-8) on top of a non-solid material. ids are persisted in saves: never change or reuse them. 0 means no fluid. flowEvery: the fluid moves on one tick in N (lava is thick). light: emitted at full depth. damagePerSecond: to the player while touching it. swimSpeedScale and moveScale scale the player's swim and walk speeds inside it.
